answer: What survives to the saffron is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the plume of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
